acceptance_conditions: tracked relative script SHA-256 matches script_sha256 and py_compile, AST parse, synthetic positive and synthetic missing-numeric tests pass
script exits 0 and writes exactly one JSON output at exact_write_paths[0]
source manifest SHA-256 equals source_evidence_manifest.source_manifest_sha256 and each bounded evidence record matches its individual SHA-256
make at most one HTTPS request to the exact official ODS asset host and read at most 2 MiB
parse only ODS content.xml with stdlib ZIP/XML, at most 32 sheets, 25,000 rows and 256 cells per row
publish rows only when one row explicitly links LLWR or Low Level Waste Repository, gaseous or air discharge wording, a numeric token and a Bq-family unit
preserve source sheet, row index, cells, row text and source unit token without conversion
if fetch, parse or explicit-row gate fails, produce evidenced NO_DATA_CONTINUE without business values
fake_data is false and inferred_values is zero
atomic commit push and remote SHA readback succeed

evidence_records.excerpt: Radioactivity in food and the environment (RIFE) report. Annual assessment report of radioactivity in food and the environment and the public's exposure to radiation. From: Environment Agency, Food Standards Agency, Natural Resources Wales and Centre for Environment, Fisheries and Aquaculture Science. Published 25 October 2018. Last updated 16 February 2026.
RIFE 30 Appendix 1 Disposals of Radioactive Waste Tables. Ref: RIFE30Appendix1Tables. ODS (OpenDocument Spreadsheet), 38.7 KB.

This report gives a detailed assessment of radioactivity in food and the environment and the public’s exposure to radiation during a specific year. It shows that the public’s exposure to permitted discharges and direct radiation near nuclear and non-nuclear sites is low and within dose limits. The report brings together the nationwide monitoring programmes of the UK’s food standard agencies and environment agencies.
